assessment_scope: The six fixed v2 assessment buildings, reused data; assessment labels are history-only and unchanged. New concrete teams are not new independent images.
display_priority_rule: Top three per route/context ranked by discovery within joint main, then actual A/B endpoint mean Q, then image count and lexicographic vector. This is declared outcome-based discovery selection, not automatic pre-collection success.
eligibility: Exact method/domain/context/n/m/A full vector represented on at least 3 discovery images and 2 buildings; all such vectors retained, with assessment capacity/missingness reported.
